title: BIFL Index
content:
BIFL: Buy It for Life # Below is a collection of the “best tools for the job” that I have researched so far.
I live by the philosophy of buying well, not often. Growing up, my family would re-buy the same shitty space heater and it would break every year. This not only creates waste on our precious planet, but it’s also more expensive in the long run!
Of course, living this philosophy requires some money, as the better quality item isn’t as cheap. But, if you save up and prioritize your funds, you can do it. You can also look into buying items used (e.g. eBay, FB marketplace/Craigslist, yard/estate sales). Often used items are in great condition, you can get a better deal, and keep an item out of the landfill.
I try to buy the thing that is not outrageously expensive, but I don’t expect to need to replace it, ever. I also value great warranties (many high-quality companies offer lifetime or multi-year manufacturer’s warranties) and most importantly replacement parts.
An item is buy-it-for-life not because it never needs care, but because it can last your lifetime or longer given maintenance and replacing parts as they break or wear out.
However, don’t throw away items you already have to replace them with something “nicer”. The best thing is the thing you already own, that already works. I only replace things once they break and I try to fix them if possible.
Note: I’ve also included some “best-picks-but-please-replace-these” items. They are denoted by a (*) in front of the entry. For example, I will list my favorite brand of underwear or favorite DIY lotion recipe, but these items are not BIFL, simply high quality and consumable.
B # ball, soccer/football: spalding neverflat I have had this ball since 2011 and it’s literally never been flat. crazy. bidet: RinseWorks Aquaus 360 RinseWorks is awesome because they sell replacement parts!! I’ve replaced both the Valve Cartridge and the lever. What’s even better is that the original lever was plastic (hence why it broke) and the replacement is brass! They noticed the part sucked and broke and made it better. bike, bicycle: (1) 1980s Gary Fisher Hoo Koo E Koo (2) 2010s Surly Midnight Special most bikes are extremely durable and can last way longer you’d think possible sheldon brown’s bicycle repair website C # car: Toyota Prius, mine is a 5th Generation Prius Plug-in Hybrid (PHEV) F # filter, reverse osmosis water: Waterdrop G3P800 or Waterdrop G5P700A H # harness, cat: mynwood cat jackets, made-to-measure headphones, overear: Bose QuietComfort 35 II humidifier: Venta LW25 Original Humidifier ultrasonic (misting) humidifiers require distilled water because they aerosolize (mist) water and all the bacteria, minerals, and chemicals in the water. this can cause lung cancer and bacterial infections. Distilled water is also quite expensive. So the Venta humidifers don’t aerosolize anything and you can use normal water in them. You should use the water treatment additive and cleaner for best performance. L # luggage: northface base camp rolling thunder 28L we have 3 sizes, 22L, 28L, 36L (*) lotion: 1:1 ratio of “butter” to oil (e.g. shea butter, cocoa butter & castor, jajoba, and avocado oil), mixed until it has the texture of whipped cream cheese. M # multitool: leatherman wave+ when i lost my first wave+ i reordered an excellent condition used wave+ on eBay P # peeler, vegetable: Kuhn Rikon (all stainless steel, carbon steel + plastic handle) R # rig, suspension/circus/aerial: VVolfy Metalworks Ludwig Quad Rig – Small 4-ft header + eyebolts #2-6 (option on the rig itself) weather resistance kit 4pc 4x4" Non-slip furniture pads S # (*) shoes, barefoot boots, work + leather jim green, anatomx barefoot african ranger boots fashionable, leather dolfie paradise fashionable, plastic / vegan leather feelgrounds courtside, but only in the cute jordans-esque colors martial arts whitin barefoot shoes running, extremely thin New balance Minimus HI-REZ: this is likely only available used (e.g. eBay / DePop). sandals bedrock carin evo sandals: while these are not ultra thin, they’re zero-drop and work great for outdoor adventures and running. U # (*) underwear: kirkland signature boxer brief, 4-pack (cotton)

title: foraging starter kit
content:
foraging starter kit # so you want to eat stuff outside? # by Matte Kirwin
last edited 28 July 2025
(sept 2022) i’m on vacation right now so this doc is incomplete. but it should have the bare minimum to get you started!
@eatingstuffoutside
getting inspired and learning # Videos: # Black Forager on TikTok and instagram is a great starting point. she’s incredibly informative, inspiring, and funny Books, general foraging # Northeast Foraging, if you live in the northeast of the US this book is the perfect starter book. you can read over what’s available in your area and then start looking for it. this was my first foraging book and i ate tons of stuff around boston using this book there are books from the same series for other regions, e.g. midwest foraging. Books, mushrooms # Mushrooming without Fear extreme beginner book, makes sure every shroom is from a completely non toxic family. so it’s impossible to get poisonous mushrooms if you’re following everything in the book Mushrooming with Confidence book by the same author. i think of this as the intermediate book that you’d read after mushrooming without fear. identification # 🌿 Foraging Tip **Golden Rule**: Always have 3 forms of positive ID before eating anything! always have 3 forms of positive ID. even then, taste test. only eat a little (tbh see if you have a bad digestive reaction). look up if it needs to be cooked first. Safety First! ⚠️ Even with proper identification, start with small amounts to test for allergic reactions. Some edible plants require cooking to be safe! the three forms of identification i use # foraging books Seek app by iNaturalist or Google Lens, these are helpful but not 100% reliable. ALWAYS check another form of ID. facebook foraging groups, local to you (literally search on FB: foraging <location> or foraging and identification <location> For Massachusetts people: Foraging Southern New England Foraging with Friends RI/MA/CT The New England Mushroom Identification Forum google “green leaves with white undersides massachusetts” google whatever you think you have found thru apps or books and TRIPLE CHECK ALL IDENTIFYING CHARACTERISTICS ARE THE SAME if you’re unsure at all DO NOT EAT

title: sourdough
content:
sourdough starter kit # sourdough recipe # Active mixing and kneading takes like 2-3 hours. It can be left in the fridge overnight, or left out at room temperature until the dough has risen.
Mix everything in one bowl
300g water 10g salt 100g active starter (eh it’s fine if it’s not totally active, as long as it’s been fed recently and there’s been enough time for the bacteria to populate all the substrate) 450 bread flour Mix everything until there’s no dry flour left Bulk fermentation / 1st rise
cover dough let rest for 30 minutes. it’ll be easier to work with after that. Stretch and folds. 30 minutes of rest between each set. 3a. FIRST ROUND stretch and fold the bread over itself. think like a compass or square. develop the gluten. do 3 sets of this. cover and let rest for 20-30 minutes or until dough is relaxed again. you don’t want to rip the gluten bonds. 3b. SECOND ROUND
same as FIRST ROUND, but you can be a bit gentler to ensusre you don’t break the gluten bonds. do 2-3 sets. cover and let rest for 20-30 minutes. 3c. THIRD ROUND
stretch and fold bread again. avoid ripping gluten bonds. you may feel air inside / see bubbles. depending on the type of crumb you want, you can press all the bubbles out or leave some. for example, if you want a crumb with big holes, you can avoid squashing the bubbles entirely. But if you like that small-bubbled sandwich bread crumb, then get the bubbles out. it’s not a huge deal at this step, but you will really choose your crumb type with the final shaping step. Dough on counter, make a boule [tbh this is optional] [TODO: fix this description lol] smooth side up, seam side down. shape dough into a ball. this helps the dough rise in one direction. make a tight ball. cover up dough in a bowl, smooth side up. let rise until doubled in size or 3.5 hours. SHAPING 5a. pre-shape don’t need flour on the counter put dough on counter, sticky / seam side down. smooth side up (top of loaf on top). preshape into a tight ball. let set on counter for 30 minutes uncovered. the slight skin will help you be by becoming nonstick. 5b. FINAL SHAPE
bannitent basket or BOWL + dish cloth, dusted with flower. also dust the dough / boule. place the bread sticky side up on the counter. pull it into a square shape. fold it into thirds like a croissant pillow then roll that guy into a ball shape. place the bread in the basket sticky / seam side up. so the “top” of the loaf is in the bowl, like it’s wearing the bowl like a helmet. except the bread is upside down in the bowl. FINAL PROOF in the fridge all night long dust top of dough with flour. place bowl and bread inisde plastic bag in the fridge. BAKING 30 min before baking, pre-heat the oven to 450F put dutch oven in there during the pre-heat. take dough out of the fridge, no thaw time needed. lift bread out of the basket. put that guy on a piece of parchment paper. score the bread with a razor blade on a chopstick. place bread in HOT dutch oven with parchment paper underneath the bread. bake with lid on for 20-30 min. open dutch oven after that and bake until browned to your liking. cool for 1 hr?

title: Hair
content:
hair # youtube channels # all these youtube channels were great resources when i was taking care of my hair and growing it out. all of them struggled with hair loss or thinning to varying degrees.
the main takeaways:
https://www.youtube.com/@heatherkarra
best hair results. she has insanely thick and long hair; struggled with hair loss closest hair type to my own scalp massage and red light is really important stress relief and an overall orientation towards self care is the most important a well balanced diet is important for hair growth https://www.youtube.com/@selfmaxxer
sunlight is important scalp massage is important; we need to massage out scalp tension https://www.youtube.com/@invertage
inversion introduces blood flow to the scalp and can reverse hair loss he recovered his hair from almost completely bald! care and growth # health # getting enough protein getting enough vitamins (e.g. through fruit and vegetable intake, supplements if dietary changes aren’t enough) if you lose a lot of body weight, your body will start shedding hair until your weight stabilizes get sunlight on your skin and scalp (vitamin d, red and near infrared light) TODO attach article mechanical factors # satin (or rather, commonly satin-like polyester) bonnet and/or pillowcase for sleeping wearing protective hairstyles most of the time, for long hair don’t rip through tangles. ripping your hair makes it shorter, duh i use a silicone scalp brush when shampooing. use scalp massage with fingers or hair brush. keep the fingers in one place and move the scalp around over the skull hair care # i don’t use sodium lauryl sulfate shampoos i apply hair oil to my ends and scalp before washing (rosemary oil, castor/jojoba/avocado oil) i like shea moisture shampoo/conditioner, or VIORI shampoo/conditioner bars, or dr. groot shampoo!

title: Cats
content: cats # litter # wood pine pellets are amazing. they are low scent, urine turns into sawdust, feces are easy to scoop out, and most importantly, there aren’t little pebbles that scatter throughout your entire house. there’s also not irritating dust that gets in your and your cat’s lungs. Tractor Supply Co. Horse Bedding Pine Pellets are the most convenient and cheapest option I found. I didn’t want to use fuel pellets because there was a risk of harmful added chemicals. harnesses # walking your cat is awesome. Mynwood Cat Jackets are awesome. I got Muffin custom-made harnesses because they were pretty much the same price as the pre-made ones. they’re made by this british lady they have the best design of any cat harness and are escape-resistant. buckle-style harnesses and harnesses for dogs are often too rigid and cats can easily escape from them. they’re customizable (fabric, embroidery, reflective strips, airtag pockets, tripod/three-legged cats etc.)
